title: On a batch integration PR, merge --lane-lint reports conflicts with later open PRs to those lanes instead of refusing
why: merge --lane-lint FAILed batch #2814 at c63629c18 on merge-tree conflicts with later open PRs #2839, #2884, #2906, not with main, and "No override lifts this refusal": a green batch cannot merge until later lanes close. It holds main.
note: Fix: on an integration PR, report other-PR conflicts to those later lanes and do not refuse. Red first on #2814 at c63629c18. Bandaid now (coordinator): runner 10 closes #2839, #2884, #2906, merges #2814, then reopens them. Rank with the stability fixes. Lane started 14:34 CST Nov 12. Bandaid ran 14:43 CST Nov 12: runner 10 closed #2839, #2884, #2906, merged #2814 (bcbeaa26a), reopened all three. Lane post-batch-conflict-merge 15:29 CST Nov 12 (#2969, head c7adf46c3).
